scientific_integrity: Global attraction and conserved foliations were established in earlier literature; this result evaluates only the explicit parameter-and-composition-dependent spectral transition, exact focus crossing clock, and the three-species threshold. Numerical checks are finite corroboration.
scientific_limitations: Single damped-center predator-prey star with positive parameters, finite positive leaves, and positive initial data; local node/focus only in conserved two-dimensional leaves. Critical repeated-eigenvalue crossing count and arbitrary graphs are not classified. Priority of the quantified spectral/basin formula remains provisional because a relevant earlier journal article could not be read in full.
title: Composition-selected focus and node relaxation in dissipative Lotka–Volterra stars
